by the Web Marketing Association, earning distinction in the banking category for Outstanding Website excellence. The award recognizes organizations that demonstrate outstanding achievement in web design, user experience, innovation, content, technology, and overall digital effectiveness.

The recognition highlights MCB's ongoing investment in digital innovation and its commitment to providing clients, prospects, and partners with an intuitive, accessible, and engaging online experience. The Bank's website serves as a central hub for information about its commercial, business, and personal banking solutions, while reflecting MCB's relationship-driven approach and dedication to exceptional client service.
"This award reflects our commitment to delivering a digital experience that is as responsive, personalized, and innovative as the banking services we provide every day," said
Dixiana Berrios, Chief Operating Officer of Metropolitan Commercial Bank
. "We continually seek ways to enhance how clients interact with our brand, access information, and discover solutions that support their financial goals."

The WebAward program is one of the longest-standing annual website award competitions dedicated to recognizing the best websites across a wide range of industries. Entries are evaluated by industry professionals against established criteria including design, innovation, content, technology, interactivity, copywriting, and ease of use.
This latest recognition adds to a growing list of accolades earned by Metropolitan Commercial Bank, reflecting the Bank's continued focus on innovation, client experience, and financial excellence.

Metropolitan Commercial Bank (“MCB”) is a New York City–based, full-service commercial bank serving businesses, institutions, and individuals who value expertise, responsiveness, and long-term partnerships. Since 1999, MCB has built enduring client relationships—many spanning generations—by delivering consistent, relationship-driven banking.

The Bank provides a full suite of commercial, business, and personal banking solutions, with deep expertise in sectors including real estate, property management, legal services, healthcare, government, and global investors utilizing EB-5 financial solutions. MCB combines specialized capabilities with a highly personalized approach, offering integrated solutions such as title and escrow services, 1031 exchanges, and merchant acquiring.

MCB has received national recognition for its performance and innovation, including being named one of Newsweek’s Best Regional Banks in 2024 and 2025 and earning industry recognition for its lending performance and specialized commercial banking capabilities.

MCB operates full-service banking centers in Manhattan and Boro Park, Brooklyn, within New York City; Great Neck on Long Island; Lakewood, New Jersey; and in South Florida, including Miami and West Palm Beach.

Metropolitan Commercial Bank is a New York State–chartered commercial bank, a member of the Federal Reserve System and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, and an equal housing lender. The Bank’s parent company is Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (NYSE: MCB).
